Document-level context for literary translation

Alex Morgan, Kai Rivera

This introductory paragraph explains the purpose of the paper and how it relates to previous research.

Abstract

This paper explains how document context helps readers understand literary translation. The evaluation dataset is available for independent research.

Context window

The context window is the set of sentences that the reader can see at the same time.

Word alignment

This glossary explains the process of matching words across the original and translated sentences.
